title: Braid Mechanic's Orbital Palace Payback
summary: At daybreak, a braid-haired mechanic led a ragtag crew, offering strange hospitality while a violinist played a jive tune. They aimed to unblock their path, despite the imagery of arsenals. With twitchy precision, the mechanic salvaged and crafted, understanding the mockery of their situation in a trafficky, shacked world. Hardcore fanatics watched, promising payback as the orbital palace warped. The air was thick with the metaphorical germs of a crash, a climax born from divvied pork rations. Finally, the errand complete, the mechanic surveyed a changed world, rejecting old racecards. A new movement vibrated with potential, signifying a fresh install of order, the nutjobs' influence gone anymore.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
